summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Augusto Graziani, an Italian economist who lived from 4 May 1933 to 5 January 2014. He held a professorship in political economy at University la Sapienza. He is best known for his contributions to monetary economics, particularly his role in founding monetary circuit theory.
one_line: Augusto Graziani was an Italian economist (1933–2014) and political economy professor known for founding monetary circuit theory.
key_facts: Augusto Graziani was born on 4 May 1933.
Augusto Graziani was an Italian economist.
Augusto Graziani was a Professor in Political Economy at University la Sapienza.
Augusto Graziani is most known for his contribution to monetary economics.
Augusto Graziani is credited with founding monetary circuit theory.
